# Description

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues when relevant.

## Validation

List the relevant commands or manual checks and their results. Explain the
behavior, integration, or structural evidence appropriate to this change.

## Review

Use GitHub review threads to discuss feedback and resolve relevant defects.
Request another review directly when a revision needs one.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has been self-reviewed.
- [ ] Relevant lint, typecheck, tests, formatting, and repository preflight pass.
- [ ] Security, privacy, storage, accessibility, licensing, and domain invariants
      touched by the change remain satisfied.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for a real fix, feature, or breaking change.
